title: Cannot addDisjunctiveFacet from widget init method

comments.body:
Right, I discovered I can do that in my `getConfiguration` method as well.

So I have it working, but still leaves me wondering when _can_ you use the `addDisjunctiveFacet` method?
You should be able to use helper.addDisjunctiveFacet in init method followed by helper.addDisjunctiveFacetRefinement in same init method but you'd have to call .search() also I guess.

Ok for future reference, helper.state.addDisjunctiveFacet creates a new state that's why it's not working. To make it work, one should:

```js
helper.setState(helper.state.addDisjunctiveFacet);
```

When adding the disjunctive facet you don't need to do a `search()` in the init, a subsequent search will be done anyway.
